title: Calculator
error.usage: Type an expression after the command, for example “/calc (15000-3200)*12”
settings.group.about: 1,234,567 or 1 234 567 with the comma: long numbers are easier to read.
settings.digits.about: How many digits a fraction keeps: 3.14 with 3, 3.141592654 with 10.
settings.supported: Understands + − × ÷ (also x and **), brackets, powers (^), percent (1000-10%), factorial (5!), √, sqrt, cbrt, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, log, ln, abs, round, floor, ceil, pi, e and ans, the last result. “2pi” and “2(1+1)” multiply without a sign. Someone else's expression: “Calculate” in the message menu, the result is copied.
